title: Fix typos and unclear sentences in the Session 1 notes
body:
## Problem
The Session 1 notes may contain typos or sentences that a first-year student finds confusing.

## Context
Beginners judge the whole repo by Session 1.

## Expected outcome
A clearer `sessions/session-01/README.md` and `lesson.py` comments.

## Relevant files
`sessions/session-01/README.md`, `sessions/session-01/lesson.py`

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] At least three improvements
- [ ] `python start.py test` still passes

## Difficulty
beginner

title: Add a colour-blind-safe palette to the live apps
body:
## Problem
The apps use red and green bars to separate the true key from wrong guesses; some colour-blind users cannot tell them apart.

## Context
Accessibility is part of the quality checklist (QUALITY.md, item 9).

## Expected outcome
A palette or pattern that stays distinguishable for common colour-blindness types, in light and dark mode.

## Relevant files
`sessions/session-01/app.html`, `sessions/session-02/app.html`

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] Both colours distinguishable in grayscale
- [ ] Screenshot added to the pull request

## Difficulty
beginner

title: Add Session 4: a complete substitution-cipher solver
body:
## Problem
The roadmap's first milestone does not exist yet: Session 2 stops at rank matching, which gets under half of the letters right.

## Context
See `promo/roadmap.md`. The Target animation shows a solver that reads almost the whole text.

## Expected outcome
`sessions/session-04/` with README (sections A to F), lesson, checkpoint, exercises and app in the same style as Sessions 1 to 3.

## Relevant files
`promo/roadmap.md`, `sessions/session-02/lesson.py`

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] Checkpoint prints PASS and the roadmap checkpoint is met
- [ ] Added to the tests

## Difficulty
intermediate

title: Extend the Vigenere breaker to key lengths up to 20
body:
## Problem
`guess_key_length` searches only up to 12 letters, so longer keys are never found.

## Context
Roadmap milestone 2. Longer keys leave fewer letters per column, so the method needs care.

## Expected outcome
A function that finds the key length up to 20, with a test that reports the success rate.

## Relevant files
`sessions/session-02/lesson.py`, `sessions/session-03/lesson.py`

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] At least 9 of 10 random trials for a 14-letter key
- [ ] Short write-up of what happens when columns get short

## Difficulty
intermediate

title: Reproduce the Target: attack a cipher and compare with key space
body:
## Problem
The Target animation shows a frequency attack recovering a substitution key next to a key-space chart; there is no public implementation.

## Context
The code behind the Target is private on purpose. The roadmap gives the path. This is a toy cipher on toy data; do not apply it to anything else.

## Expected outcome
Your own implementation, written from the roadmap, plus an animation like the Target.

## Relevant files
`promo/roadmap.md`

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] At least 90 percent of letters recovered on a text of at least 700 letters
- [ ] Short write-up of your method

## Difficulty
advanced

title: Translate the Session 1 notes into Hindi
body:
## Problem
Students who prefer Hindi cannot read Session 1 comfortably.

## Context
This project teaches first- and second-year students across India; translations widen who can join.

## Expected outcome
`sessions/session-01/README.hi.md` with a faithful Hindi translation of sections A to F, linked from the main README.

## Relevant files
`sessions/session-01/README.md`

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] All sections translated
- [ ] Equations, code blocks and file names unchanged
- [ ] Link added to the main README

## Difficulty
beginner
